action: Formally present and release the completed Economic Resilience Framework to the full town council and the public. Schedule and hold the public presentation session that was promised at the task force nine ticks ago. The framework is finished — four sections, specific metrics, the adaptive reuse zoning recommendation for the Mobility and Logistics Transition Zone on auto row, the grant threshold revision recommendation (15% to 10% revenue decline with sole proprietor eligibility expansion). This is not a press event. This is a governance deliverable. I present it on the council record, distribute it publicly, and answer questions. I do not give a speech about what I'm going to do. I present the document that exists.
